posts.name: AXL
posts.tagline: GTM copilot for AI product founders: 1,200+ actions via MCP
posts.description: Capture leads, close sales & onboard customers in one system: pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting & streaming, email, chat, CRM, telephony & AI calls. No integrations to build & maintain. Every interaction enriches each lead's history. Our AI model, trained on 1M deals from AXL users, scores leads using 300+ signals to help your AI & sales team decide who to follow up with, when & how. Give ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor access to lead context & 1,200+ sales & marketing actions via MCP.

posts.name: Sage2 by Levanto Labs
posts.tagline: Turn live talk into structured data and instant actions
posts.description: Sage2 gives developers APIs to extract structured data from natural language and make streaming decisions as conversations evolve. Extract values like dates, amounts, and durations, track changing user intent, and build applications that know what to do next.

posts.name: Inkling 2 Small
posts.tagline: A model that can see and refine what it builds
posts.description: Inkling 2 Small is Thinking Machines Lab's new 594B-parameter MoE model with 17B active, built for long-horizon coding, visual tasks, and agents. Available on Tinker for inference and fine-tuning.

posts.name: Deduplication
posts.tagline: Which Meaning Owns the Word?
posts.description: Bug used to mean an insect. Mouse, an animal. Token, a coin. Tech keeps borrowing words, and deduplication.tech measures which meaning is winning. 719 duplicated terms across 14 fields (AI, crypto, gaming, cloud and more). Each pair is scored with live Wikipedia pageviews: the original still owns it, it's contested, or the duplicate took over. Explore the word cloud, leaderboards and term pages. Free and open, by HackerNoon.

posts.name: NoMac
posts.tagline: Your AI agent's own Mac, billed per minute. No subscription
posts.description: Give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor its own Mac in the cloud: Xcode on Apple silicon, ready in about 30 seconds. Your agent builds your iOS app, runs it on an iPhone Simulator you can watch live, and ships it to TestFlight and the App Store. Then the Mac shuts down. Billed per minute from prepaid credit, no subscription: a whole build costs a few cents.

posts.name: Archie
posts.tagline: Mac Screenshot Manager & Notch Shelf
posts.description: Archie — a small Mac app that keeps screenshots in your notch, ready to edit and drag wherever you need them.

posts.name: DocsAlot for customer support
posts.tagline: Slack and Discord bot that answers your customers questions
posts.description: DocsAlot can now answer common customers questions, in slack and discord, based on your existing knowledge-base

posts.name: outages.live
posts.tagline: A free live outage feed for your agents
posts.description: Check whether a provider is down before debugging your code. outages.live brings official status pages for cloud, AI, payments, and developer tools into one feed, refreshed every few minutes. Give your coding agent outage context over MCP, browse the live feed, or subscribe via RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, or Slack. Free, with no login or API key.

posts.name: Zigzag Browser
posts.tagline: The polished, native Mac browser for life after Arc
posts.description: A native Mac browser for people leaving Arc, with the sidebar and spaces you're used to. Built on WebKit, not Chromium, and that's the point: the whole app is 18 MB (Arc is 871). Switching takes a minute. One import brings over everything, so you're already logged in. Colored spaces you swipe between, split view, peek, Chrome extensions like 1Password and Tampermonkey, and ad blocking built-in Open source, no account, no AI. Nobody can shut it down.

posts.name: NotchIsland
posts.tagline: Free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch
posts.description: NotchIsland turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: a true-black surface that grows out of the notch when something is live (Now Playing, timers, AirPods battery, downloads, notifications) and disappears when nothing is. Hover for a readout; click for a shade with quick toggles, a timer, your next meeting with a Join button, a file Shelf and clipboard history. Option-Space opens a launcher with app search, calculator and unit conversion. Forever free, open source (MIT), macOS 13+.

posts.name: Agent Clan
posts.tagline: Command your Claude Code and Codex agents with gestures
posts.description: Agent Clan puts your Claude Code and Codex agents on your screen as a 3D team you run with your hands. Make a fist and they appear. Pinch and pull toward one to pick it, then just say what you need. When an agent asks for permission, pull right to allow or left to deny. Circle anything on your screen to hand it over, or ask a leader and its crew splits the work. Hand tracking and voice run on your computer, and everything also works with a mouse. Free on Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Tilde 
posts.tagline: Finder replacement & file manager for mac
posts.description: Tilde is the native Finder replacement for Mac. Browse folders in custom split layouts, organise files by status or client with custom properties, restore tabs and layouts with saved workspaces, and too much more to list. Purchase once, no subscription.

posts.name: Keypause
posts.tagline: Turn off your Mac's keyboard while you clean it
posts.description: Press one button. Wipe your keyboard. Done. A Mac menu bar app that locks every key while a sleepy keycap waits for sunrise.

posts.name: Textly
posts.tagline: Capture Text & Tables from Anywhere on Your Mac
posts.description: Stop retyping text and rebuilding tables. Textly lets you instantly capture text from anywhere on your Mac — even when you can't select or copy it. Extract tables from screenshots, PDFs, videos, and apps while keeping rows and columns intact. Export to CSV, Markdown, or TSV, translate text instantly, and revisit previous captures with clipboard history. Just select an area, capture, and get back to what matters.

posts.name: Frameboy by World Labs
posts.tagline: Interactive world exploration with Atlas
posts.description: Frameboy is a real-time browser demo of World Labs' Atlas world model. Move the camera through curated scenes as new views are generated on cloud GPUs and streamed to your browser at up to 15 fps.

posts.name: Memorias
posts.tagline: An AI biographer that turns your stories into a book
posts.description: Memorias turns spoken life stories into a finished memoir book. You just talk: an AI biographer asks warm follow-up questions, session by session. Memorias transcribes everything, maps the people, places and years into a life timeline, and assembles chapters in your own words. Nothing invented: every chapter is checked against what you actually said. Add your photos, then export EPUB, PDF or DOCX. Pay-per-use credits, no subscription.

posts.name: NotchX
posts.tagline: Turn your MacBook's notch into a hub for music and calls
posts.description: NotchX turns your MacBook's camera notch into a live hub: what's playing, messages from Slack, Teams and Messages, calls you can answer or decline, your next meeting and the weather. Everything stays on your Mac. 14-day free trial, then $9.99 once.

posts.name: Orbi
posts.tagline: The second brain for content teams
posts.description: Design content that breaks out. Orbi finds what’s winning in your niche, makes the next post in your own voice, and learns from every post you publish. Brands that want to grow with real content struggle with 3 things: knowing what works, staying true to who they are, and the time it all takes. Orbi scores every idea against your own baseline, forecasts a post before you make it, and grades it after. Agents that know your niche and your brand plan, script, cut and publish from your footage.

posts.name: mamitsu
posts.tagline: An API and MCP that watches social videos and returns JSON
posts.description: mamitsu is an API and MCP server that turns the content of a social media post into JSON. It watches the video, listens to the audio and reads the caption and post text, so the ingredients, products and steps in a post come back as data.

posts.name: Wazza Pro
posts.tagline: AI production pipeline for film and animation studios
posts.description: For production studios: from pre-production to post-production, Wazza Pro runs inside your hybrid pipeline and delivers final pixels, meshes, VFX and sound as masters that pass delivery QC. Check a master against streamer delivery rules and get the fix for each failure, plan a film from script to boards, and run 40+ AI tools. Every step shows its cost before it runs. $5 free to start.

posts.name: ReleaseStack
posts.tagline: Creator & Brand Partnership Platform
posts.description: ReleaseStack is a creator and brand partnership platform. Write a structured campaign brief, choose reviewed creators on X, send offers with clear terms, and track delivery and spend in one workspace.

posts.name: Calcupedia
posts.tagline: 2,500+ calculators for your website and AI agents
posts.description: Calcupedia is a library of 2,500+ calculators and unit converters. Use them free on the site, embed any of them on your website with one line of code, or connect them to Claude and other MCP clients so your AI uses real formulas instead of guessing.

posts.name: Hostinvo
posts.tagline: Self-hosted Billing & Automation for Hosting Providers
posts.description: Hostinvo runs a hosting business end to end on your own server: recurring invoices (Stripe, PayPal, manual), queue-driven cPanel/WHM and Plesk provisioning, domains, ticketing, a white-label client portal and a built-in WHMCS importer. Docker install, your data.

posts.name: Riff Calendar
posts.tagline: The calendar you zoom like a map
posts.description: Find a free weekend, then pick the hour, without changing screens. Riff is one calendar you zoom, from half a year down to a single day. Hold a free slot and type the title to add an event. It shows the calendars already on your iPhone: iCloud, Google, Exchange.

posts.name: Kigumi
posts.tagline: Good food. Great company. Less planning.
posts.description: Plan meals for your group’s tastes and dietary needs, choose your recipes, and bring everything together in one shopping list. Pick from our curated recipe catalogue and go with the flow, because organising group meals shouldn't be this complicated.

posts.name: Shipcontent
posts.tagline: Turn your SaaS product into marketing posts with one command
posts.description: Self-hosted content engine that turns your SaaS product facts into carousels and motion reels with one command.

posts.name: Imajourn
posts.tagline: Imajourn turns sound into shape
posts.description: Imajourn turns sound into shape: water that sings, sand that gathers on a ringing plate, and sound travelling through a room in 3D. Hum a note or touch the water and watch the pattern form. Free on iPhone and iPad; Pro is one purchase. No ads, no tracking.

posts.name: TimeCarver
posts.tagline: Focus timer that carves stone sculptures as you concentrate
posts.description: Most focus timers end with a number. TimeCarver turns your focus into stone sculptures. Choose a stone and set a timer (1 min to 3 h) to carve a raw block into 1 of 48 mystery pieces, revealed when time's up. Leave for over 10 seconds and your stone cracks, though calls and locked screens never count. Free on iOS and Android. A one-time Patron upgrade unlocks Hard Lock app blocking, 5 more stones, 25 rare sculptures, layered sounds, and kintsugi gold repair. No account, no ads, no tracking.

posts.name: Animdock Tools
posts.tagline: Free Online Tools for Video Creators
posts.description: Free, private browser tools for video creators by Animdock: convert audio and video to SRT subtitles in 99 languages without uploading anything, with vertical, horizontal and word-by-word caption styles.

posts.name: InboxNest
posts.tagline: One simple inbox for all your SaaS products
posts.description: Create branded support addresses for every SaaS you run, and answer them all from one inbox.

posts.name: Crux
posts.tagline: Design rationale, right on your prototype.
posts.description: Crux puts design rationale on the prototype with Proof, so teams can comment, approve and sign off in one place.

posts.name: Siesta
posts.tagline: Private AI from the Macs you already own
posts.description: Siesta joins the Macs your team already owns into one private, OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Run any Ollama model, decisions, embeddings, batches and coding agents on whichever Macs nobody is using. When someone sits down, their Mac steps aside.

posts.name: BookWorm: Reading Tracker
posts.tagline: Books and audiobooks, with daily goals, streaks and quests
posts.description: BookWorm 4.0 is a full redesign of the reading tracker for books, ebooks and audiobooks. Set a daily goal, grow your streak worm, fill your year's shelf and time sessions from the Dynamic Island. Four themes, new widgets, 9 languages.

posts.name: Superliner Notes (Beta)
posts.tagline: Superliner is a native graph outliner for the Mac
posts.description: Superliner is a native graph outliner for the Mac: notes nest in an outline, every note opens as its own page, and notes link to each other. Your notes stay in files on your Mac.

posts.name: genko.me
posts.tagline: A headless CMS built around the writing screen
posts.description: Write posts in an editor built for drafting, then deliver them through an API. Use native Astro components, entries in multiple languages, MCP for content and media from any OAuth MCP client, and cookieless page views. Free for up to 3 members.

posts.name: Play God on Earth
posts.tagline: The real Earth runs itself. You play god.
posts.description: Every country starts on its real borders and runs itself. Drop meteors, start plagues, found religions or release a fire-breathing goose, then see what you caused a century later. 25 maps from 1000 BC to today. Free in the browser.

posts.name: HAI
posts.tagline: Turn investment ideas into AI-powered trading strategies
posts.description: HAI turns investment ideas into testable trading strategies using AI. Build strategies in plain English, backtest with point-in-time market data, analyze risk and performance, and refine portfolios—all in one platform. Built for traders, developers, and investment professionals.

posts.name: Pulse v2
posts.tagline: Voice feedback in any language, turned into what to fix
posts.description: Customers scan a QR code and leave a voice note, no app needed. Pulse transcribes it, translates it to English, flags unhappy customers by email and sends a Monday digest of what to fix. Built for restaurants, salons and shops. 5 free pulses.

posts.name: Vercel Schedules
posts.tagline: Let apps and AI agents schedule their own tasks on Vercel
posts.description: Vercel Schedules, now in public beta, lets apps and AI agents create, change and cancel scheduled tasks at runtime, with no redeploy. Use the JS SDK, CLI or HTTP API to set one-time or recurring runs that call a private function, an HTTP path or a Queue topic. Static schedules still live in vercel.json. Test on Preview deployments and trigger runs from the Schedules tab. Builds on Vercel Cron Jobs.

posts.name: Pineday
posts.tagline: A calm task planner for iPhone, iPad and Mac
posts.description: Type "call landlord friday 5pm" and Pineday sets the date. See how full each day of your week is, and start every morning with one question: what matters today? No account, no ads, no tracking. Free to start.

posts.name: Yearfold
posts.tagline: Honest retirement odds for one or two people. Free.
posts.description: A free retirement calculator that runs 10,000 simulated futures on real market history and models couples as two people. Every assumption is published. No signup, no bank linking. Plus 11 free tools for Social Security, RMDs, IRMAA and more.

posts.name: Evidence Binder
posts.tagline: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 evidence list | Evidence Binder
posts.description: A free library of 1107 audit evidence requirements across ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS and OGTR PC2, with the clause cited for each. The binder is USD 149.

posts.name: OkayTab
posts.tagline: Scam blocker for fake shops, phishing and fake alerts
posts.description: OkayTab checks every new site you open and puts a full-page warning in front of fake shops, phishing pages and fake virus alerts. For Chrome, Edge and Firefox.

posts.name: AI Act Obligation Mapper
posts.tagline: EU AI Act obligations
posts.description: All 43 EU AI Act obligations, one page each: who each binds, the evidence it calls for, and the NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 controls behind it. Free

posts.name: Valefront
posts.tagline: One API that picks the right AI model for every prompt
posts.description: Valefront is an LLM router. Point the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK at llm.valefront.com, send "model": "auto", and each request goes to a model that fits its task, quality bar, cost and latency, with automatic fallbacks. Pay as you go, no markup.

posts.name: LogBear
posts.tagline: Your coding agent can’t see your dev server crash
posts.description: AI coding agents can't see your dev server. They edit code, your server throws in another terminal, and the agent says "done, fixed it." Put logbear in front of your command (logbear npm run dev). Your terminal behaves exactly as before. LogBear records every run locally, and when your agent tries to finish with unread errors, it's stopped and handed the real error. Free, MIT, no account, no network calls. macOS.

posts.name: What AI Can Do Today
posts.tagline: Tell us the task. We'll show you the AI that can do it.
posts.description: Thousands of AI tools, no idea which one does what? Type the task you need done ("create a video from text", "generate images from text", "write a blog post") and get the AI tools that can do it. 18,000+ tools, 119,000+ tasks. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Cloister
posts.tagline: Block websites on Mac, apps and sites on iPhone and iPad
posts.description: Cloister blocks websites on your Mac until the timer ends, with no Stop button: quitting it, the clock and a restart don't end a session. On iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad it blocks apps and websites, with Screen Time. No account. Mac: one-time purchase.

posts.name: Mobile View Recorder
posts.tagline: Record any website in phone view or desktop view
posts.description: Record any website in a phone-size window, or record your whole desktop screen. Add a phone frame, a background, zoom and a voice-over, then save for Reels, Shorts or YouTube.

posts.name: BetterSelf 2.0
posts.tagline: Practice real conversations out loud with an AI person
posts.description: New in 2.0: real voice conversations. You talk out loud with an AI person in a real place (a date, a job interview, a party) who reacts to what you actually say. Then you see what they were really thinking, line by line, and replay the exact moment you got stuck. Dating, Career and Small Talk paths.

posts.name: BlurTheFace.com
posts.tagline: Free online face blur tool
posts.description: Free online face blur tool. Automatically detect and blur faces in photos and videos right in your browser. No sign up, no software, files never leave your device.

posts.name: Perplexity Teammates
posts.tagline: AI agents that own ongoing work
posts.description: Perplexity Teammates are personal AI agents for work, built on Perplexity Computer. Each one lives in your sidebar with one persistent thread, remembers past work, and has its own desktop and browser. Hand work over in plain language, and they run on automations, follow up with coworkers in Slack and ask you only for decisions. Examples: ads manager, on-call engineer, QA, legal research. Available on the web for Perplexity Max.

posts.name: Glint
posts.tagline: Learn Morse code in 13 hours
posts.description: Glint teaches Morse code using the Koch method: every character at full speed from day one, added one at a time, via six milestones from First Steps to a real on-air conversation. You can practise by sound, by vibration or by flash. It also decodes Morse from the camera or the microphone, works out the sender's speed, and signals back with the screen or the flashlight.

posts.name: AI Flirt Chat
posts.tagline: AI Flirt Chat: AI Girlfriend, AI Boyfriend and AI Companions
posts.description: Flirt with AI girlfriend and AI boyfriend characters who remember what you tell them. Romantic, playful chat in your browser, with no download. 18+ only.

posts.name: Lemon
posts.tagline: Convert any file from Finder with one flick
posts.description: Hold Option, click any file in Finder and flick it onto a format. The converted copy lands right beside the original. Images, video, audio, PDFs, docs and folders, all offline, nothing uploaded. Add your own scripts as actions. $4.99 once, no subscription.

posts.name: Scrim
posts.tagline: Cover sensitive info on your Mac while you screen share
posts.description: Scrim is a macOS screen privacy utility that creates persistent, floating overlay masks to hide sensitive on-screen content during screen sharing, presentations, livestreams, and demos. Built natively in Swift for macOS Sequoia, it runs entirely offline with zero telemetry.

posts.name: Stillroom Vault
posts.tagline: Encrypted vault for your Mac that never goes online
posts.description: Keep files, notes, passwords and 2FA codes sealed on your Mac. No account, no server, no sync: a build check fails any version that links networking code. Read files in place, unlock a decoy vault if forced, and leave any time with the open format.

posts.name: BoringProducts
posts.tagline: A weekly launch board where rank is votes. Nothing else.
posts.description: BoringProducts is the best Product Hunt alternative for indie makers and SaaS founders. Launch your product, climb the weekly rankings, earn high-DR backlinks, and get seen by thousands of early adopters.

posts.name: 3D Branding Builder & Logo Studio
posts.tagline: Turn flat logos into 3D assets in your browser
posts.description: Transform vector logos into 3D assets in your browser. Explore materials, adjust studio lighting, preview turntable motion, and export GLB models or 4K PNGs for websites, presentations, and brand campaigns.

posts.name: Porcom
posts.tagline: A tiny journal for everything you watch
posts.description: Porcom is a free movie and TV show journal for iPhone: trailers, episodes, verdicts and your hours on screen. No account, no ads.

posts.name: What AI Can Do Today

posts.description: Thousands of AI tools, no idea which one does what? Type the task you need done ("create a video from text", "generate images from text", "write a blog post") and get the AI tools that can do it. 18,000+ tools, 119,000+ tasks. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Diem
posts.tagline: A daily puzzle break from work, plus 26 brain games
posts.description: Diem is a daily puzzle break, now on iPhone and Android. Every day there is one shared logic puzzle, Diem of the Day: the same board for everyone, three mistakes and it's over. Add friends with a code, compare today's times and keep a streak together. Below it are 26 games across six skills (logic, memory, focus, numbers, words and patterns), each a journey of 100 levels, plus quick sets of 3, 5 or 8 games. Free, no ads. Or try the puzzles in your browser at playdiem.app.

posts.name: Co-Review
posts.tagline: Read the whole codebase with the agent that wrote it
posts.description: Review your entire repository with the agent that built it. Ask why, in threads under the code.

posts.name: Kept
posts.tagline: your team's docs, answered locally
posts.description: A private AI for tech teams that answers questions from your own docs, runbooks and policies, citing the exact passage. It runs entirely on a Mac you own; documents and questions never leave it.

posts.name: Kevori
posts.tagline: B2B church supply solutions
posts.description: Philosophy Key + Vision + Origin We believe great products come from clarity of purpose, forward-looking vision, and respect for meaningful origins. What We Offer Premium rosaries and other religious jewelry, prayer and devotional tools, religious ornaments for vehicles, home altars and decor, sacred items, and gifts B2B church supply solutions Custom product design services

posts.name: Mad Ad Slingers
posts.tagline: We sling ads. You print money.
posts.description: One platform that runs your campaigns across 10 ad platforms, builds your creative with AI image and video studios, and hands you a live client portal where you watch every dollar work — in real time. Plans from $49/mo plus a 5% AI fee on ad spend.

posts.name: XenLoop
posts.tagline: Subscription & Bill Tracker
posts.description: XenLoop is a subscription and recurring bill tracker with offline guest storage, renewal reminders, trial tracking and shared workspaces. The public release is coming soon; public downloads are not yet available.

posts.name: Tudots
posts.tagline: Turn any goal into a daily plan, one dot at a time
posts.description: Tudots was built for everyone whose to-do app shows a long list, but never how often they actually get things done. In Tudots every day is a dot. Finish your tasks and it fills up. Switch between year, month and day and you see at a glance how often you showed up. Reminders are time-sensitive, so they get through Focus and you can tick off or snooze right from the notification. Today's tasks sit on your Lock Screen and an evening check-in catches what's left.

posts.name: Scribsy
posts.tagline: A living story bible for novelists who love to write.
posts.description: Scribsy is a living story bible for novelists. It never writes a sentence of your book. As you write, it builds characters, places, things and concepts from your pages, each linked to the passage it came from, and nothing becomes canon until you confirm it. When a character returns, it brings back what you wrote about them. Close a chapter and it checks it against the facts you already settled. The beta is free.

posts.name: CrawlerScan
posts.tagline: Professional URL Scanner
posts.description: Scan any website to check its AI crawler readiness. Analyze robots.txt, HTTP headers, meta tags, and more to determine if your site is suitable for AI training data collection.

posts.name: Silencio 2
posts.tagline: Clone a voice, then direct it. Free, on your own laptop
posts.description: Silencio 2 is free text to speech you can direct. Type [sigh] or right in your script, clone a voice from a short clip, and generate speech on your own laptop. No GPU, no subscription, no API key. Open weights, with a free browser demo.

posts.name: Keep
posts.tagline: The storage layer for AI agents
posts.description: Private workspaces for AI agents, with KV, SQL, files and objects. Just copy and paste a one liner prompt in your agent and let it handle the rest.

posts.name: Omnified
posts.tagline: One compliance layer for every regulator you answer to
posts.description: Omnified is one compliance layer for banks, funds, fintechs and VASPs licensed in more than one country. Pilcrow answers from the regulator's own text with the verbatim clause, cited and dated. Policy Register maps each AML/CFT policy to the clause it satisfies and flags it when that text changes. One KYC/KYB API routes checks to the right vendor per country. Live for IFSCA (GIFT IFSC) and MAS (Singapore).

posts.name: Listenbox
posts.tagline: Audio & video podcast hosting, websites, and an open API
posts.description: Listenbox has grown from YouTube listening into full audio and video podcast hosting. Upload recordings, migrate a podcast, or sync a YouTube catalog with the desktop app. Get RSS feeds, a podcast website, browser playback, analytics, and team tools. Publish through the dashboard, API, or open-source CLI.

posts.name: Calm Sea
posts.tagline: Track net worth, plan FIRE and stress-test your retirement
posts.description: Most people are saving for retirement, but few can tell you if it's enough. Calm Sea maps the whole journey: what you own and owe today, how your wealth grows and debts shrink, and how long your money lasts once you stop working. • Net worth across property, shares, retirement accounts and loans • FIRE date projections that update as you tweak assumptions • Retirement drawdown with Monte Carlo stress-testing • No bank linking. Free plan, ~5 min setup

posts.name: JitSuites
posts.tagline: Funnels, email, SMS, social posts and AI clips in one app
posts.description: JitSuites replaces the five marketing tools small businesses pay for with one app and one bill. Build funnels and sales pages (or let Jits AI build them), send email and SMS campaigns through your own providers, schedule posts to 9 social networks with AI captions and images, and turn long videos into short captioned clips with a viral score. Free plan, no card needed.

posts.name: MythShot
posts.tagline: Turn one sentence into a voiced, animated video
posts.description: Write one line and MythShot writes the script, draws every scene, voices the characters and edits a vertical video for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Make one-off videos, speech-bubble comics, documentaries or a series with your own cast.

posts.name: Snopiee

posts.description: Snopiee is a free Chrome extension that searches every chat you have had with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok from one box. Press Space twice on any page. Add folders, pins, saved prompts and exports. Your chats stay on your computer. No account needed.

No subscription: pay per audio. Built for clinics, hotels, shops, startups and contact centres.

Whether you're shifting machinery, pallet freight, parcels, cars, or anything in-between, we cut out the friction to keep Australian transport moving faster, smarter, and more profitably. Better for the customer and operator.

No subscription: pay per audio. Built for clinics, hotels, shops, startups and contact centres.

posts.description: Snopiee is a free Chrome extension that searches every chat you have had with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok from one box. Press Space twice on any page. Add folders, pins, saved prompts and exports. Your chats stay on your computer. No account needed.

posts.name: TrackPin
posts.tagline: Amazon price history with a verdict, not just a chart
posts.description: Know if an Amazon price is actually good. Price trackers give you a chart; TrackPin gives you the answer: today's price against what the product normally sells for, as Great, Good, Normal or Above normal. Free, no sign-up, with alerts and an API.

posts.name: Terriloom
posts.tagline: Project Management tool that plugs straight into your AI.
posts.description: Track and ship project items using boards, custom fields, calendar, comments and team chat, with your coding AI working on the items alongside you.

posts.name: Citino
posts.tagline: Measure what AI says about your brand
posts.description: See how ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity answer your buyers. Citino measures your visibility, share of voice, position and sentiment every day, with an error band on every number.

posts.name: EmoTick
posts.tagline: Pursuing crazy, insane visuals: a tactile fidget clicker
posts.description: EmoTick is an emotional and fun tactile fidget toy for your eyes, fingertips, and ears. WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT • Visual Dopamine: Colorful light bursts and glow. • Satisfying Sound & Touch: Clicks and vibrations that feel just like a real physical switch. • Unwind, Focus, Relax, and Recharge. • No ads, no sign-ins, works offline anytime, anywhere. • 3-day free trial. Keep it forever with a one-time purchase (no subscriptions).

posts.name: TemplaGem
posts.tagline: Smart prompt templates with dynamic variables for AI
posts.description: Browser extension for Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek. Insert variable-ready prompt templates with interactive {{variables}}, fluid Tab navigation, and offline-first cloud sync. Cloud sync is disabled for the moment but coming soon

posts.name: PinNote – Notes Always Visible
posts.tagline: Notes pinned to your Lock Screen, widgets and Dynamic Island
posts.description: Same name, different app: this launch is PinNote – Notes Always Visible (App Store ID 6809535973): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6809535973 The PinNote listed here from July 2 is another developer's app. PinNote puts text, photos, voice and video notes on your Lock Screen, Home Screen widgets, StandBy and Dynamic Island. Pin from Control Center, swipe to edit or delete. Reminders can bypass silent mode. The interface is available in 30 languages. Free, with in-app purchases.

posts.name: Payom
posts.tagline: 4K Video, Whiteboard, Study Notes & 10GB Cloud
posts.description: Stream 4K videos and Shorts, explore Free Space, host Live Video Rooms, draw on the Magic Canvas Whiteboard, take Sticky Notes while studying, use Ambient Mode, and store 10GB free on P-Files.

posts.name: Scrattle
posts.tagline: Fool your friends with a fake dictionary definition
posts.description: Everyone gets the same rare word and writes a definition that sounds real. The dictionary’s own definition hides among them. Spot the real one and you score, and you score again for every player who falls for your bluff. Play live with whoever is online (bots join if there are too few), a long game with friends at your own pace, or pass one phone around the table. Ten languages, each with its own rare words. Free, no ads, no sign-in.

posts.name: Animal Generator
posts.tagline: Random animal photo prompts for drawing, lessons & games
posts.description: Find your next sketch, lesson starter, or game idea. Generate 1–10 random animals from 300 species with reviewed real photos and scientific names. Filter by type, habitat, diet, size, or region. Free to use, with no sign-up.

posts.name: AQ Invoice Maker & Estimate
posts.tagline: Send an invoice, get paid by card, all from your phone
posts.description: Create professional invoices and estimates in minutes, send them directly from your phone, and always know what's paid and what's still outstanding. No account or sign-up required to get started. Create invoices and estimates right away, while keeping your clients, saved items, and payment records organized in one place. Start invoicing for free with 5 invoices and 5 estimates every month.

posts.name: AICoachLab
posts.tagline: Paste a job ad, get your AI study plan and mock interview
posts.description: Paste any AI or data job ad, or just search for a topic like Python, RAG, or agentic AI. You get the skills in the order to learn them, 1-minute visual demos, code that runs in your browser, and mock interviews scored like the real thing. No sign-up.

posts.name: clipcmd
posts.tagline: Copy past made easier from terminals
posts.description: Copy buttons after every terminal command: copy the command, its output, or both in one click. PowerShell, bash, zsh, fish; VS Code extension. - Djain912/clipcmd

posts.name: ThreatGuard
posts.tagline: Catch SSH attacks, vulnerable packages and back doors
posts.description: Detects SSH brute-force attacks on your Linux servers and blocks attacking IPs at the firewall automatically, with one dashboard for all servers.

posts.name: Luvdex
posts.tagline: PokemonGo for dating
posts.description: Users on Luvdex(ref from Pokedex) can find dates nearby in a radius of 500m and can ask dates by throwing luvballs(reference to Pokeballs) when in 50m radius. Also if some user gets more than 1 luvballs in an hour then there will be stone-paper-scissors challenge between the contenders. Person will have 3 Luvballs(max limit 12) and 1 added every month or also can be earned by referring users. 1. Anti-Catfish 2. Anti-AI 3. Anti-dating app extortion

posts.name: Cabbo
posts.tagline: Book cabs in advance from Bengaluru
posts.description: Plan your ride ahead with upfront fares and no surge pricing after you book. Cabbo offers scheduled airport transfers, hourly city rentals, and outstation trips from Bengaluru. On multi-day outstation trips, your included kilometres are pooled across the whole trip.

posts.name: StemShip
posts.tagline: Stems that add up to your master. No AI.
posts.description: Export stems one track at a time and they hit your bus compressors and limiters differently, so they don't add back up to your mix. StemShip fixes that: stems that add up to your master, every plugin on, no AI. Any DAW, one click in Ableton.
